description: Read-only lookup of exact acknowledged role-row display receipts for the calling session's currently held roles. Used by wake reconciliation; a missing result is not served and a scalar watermark alone is never suppression authority.
embedding_description: Check whether named role spool rows have exact immutable display receipts for this calling session and its currently held roles. Wake reconciliation uses this read-only lookup before suppressing a durable role delivery: missing, malformed, foreign, or failed lookup results are never evidence that a row was served.
